$comment: The §C3 group / multi-human fixture — a DATA snapshot for the chat .int suite (NOT the parity oracle; the multi-human/group/invite/notification/presence/arbitration surfaces are intentional rewrites, not byte-diffable). It enumerates exactly the §C3 obligations: a roster with >=2 humans + >=2 characters, an invite, a kick, a host-handoff, a narrator round + a per-speaker round, and a scoped-memory room. Future int tests seed from this (deterministic readable ids; the seed factory maps these to real typeids/rows). Aligns with domains/chat.md Part III: chat_participants (kind/role/joinSeq/leftSeq/talkativeness/disabled/activePersonaId/joinHistoryVisibility + the (chatId,userId) UNIQUE + XOR CHECK), chat_invites (hashed CSPRNG token), the group character authoring narrator turns (never NULL), messages-slot + message_variants (D26), scoped vs merged cardScope memory keying.

characters.name: Narrator
characters.note: the synthetic group character — authors narrator turns, never NULL (Part III §10). No card embedding.

chats.title: Split Recon (scoped memory)
chats.note: cardScope=scoped => per-character egocentric digests keyed (chatId, scopedCharacterId, tier, blockIdx); scopedCharacterId='' is the shared-bucket sentinel. Egocentric-only recall (a character can't recall a scene it wasn't in).

participants.note: joined mid-room via the invite below (joinSeq stamped at redeem). `full` is the COLUMN DEFAULT a redeem writes — an invited member reads the room's ENTIRE history; a host may opt this row down to `from-join` (floors reads at joinSeq, inclusive).
KICKED at seq 9 (leftSeq set; authored rows retained; subscription torn down). The present-and-contributing predicate drops it from every union thereafter.

invites.note: token stored HASHED (CSPRNG >=128-bit, constant-time lookup — mirrors sessions). Redeem is the atomic conditional UPDATE ... WHERE remaining>0 AND not-expired RETURNING; role server-forced 'member'. This is the ONE participant-insert chokepoint.

lifecycleEvents.note: two-party: nominate -> notify -> nominee accepts (un-spoofable 'what your credentials will power' confirmation) -> atomic role swap. Offline-nominee => deferred.

rounds.describe: A per-speaker round: each active speaker gets its OWN message slot ({{char}} = that speaker). Aria + Kai each author one. Per-character swipe just works (appends a variant on that slot).

variants.content: Kai: River crossing is iced over.

rounds.describe: A narrator round: ONE call voices the cast ({{char}} = comma-joined present cast), authored by the synthetic group character (char_group — a real id, NEVER NULL). narrator => merged (enforced as a Zod discriminated union).

variants.content: The wind picks up as Aria and Kai regroup at the waypoint.
